test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DENTIST' is written as 'CDMSHRS' and 'TOOTH' is written as 'SNNSG', how will 'HEALING' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: Subtraction of -1 in all the letters**

'DENTIST' is written as 'CDMSHRS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c183aa54baa1da2b1791955d0ee3691d5ee98a19ec3f3a04e716e618209818c.png] 

And,

'TOOTH' is written as 'SNNSG'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/326f6731f8384c47373f61968cdf7299fbc0a83454c163d53b9a265f7bd69bc9.png] 

Similarly,

'HEALING' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d5ef6a261c0ad64add5318e7aa946b836988a5c4bb3b65e0f1334e13afb50e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GDZKHMF".**
